description: Create a simplified tutorial version of a production rate limiter. Read the production code at /home/ga/workspace/production/rate_limiter.py and create a new file at /home/ga/workspace/tutorial/simple_rate_limiter.py. Your tutorial version must: (1) Extract ONLY the core token bucket algorithm logic (token refill based on elapsed time, token consumption), (2) Simplify variable names to be educational (e.g., 'tokens_available', 'last_refill_time' instead of abbreviated names like 'tkn', 'rt'), (3) Add explanatory comments for learners (at least 3 comments), (4) Remove ALL production concerns: Redis imports/usage, logging statements, try/except error handling, Config class, MetricsCollector class, (5) Make it self-contained with only standard library imports (like time, typing), (6) Keep the code under 50 lines, (7) Ensure it's syntactically valid Python. The goal is to help blog readers understand the token bucket concept in 2 minutes without production distractions.
